text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf has made her mark on
the Twinkle
Series, just as she always
hoped.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And now that we're moving on to the
next stage
of our lives, I find myself
taking a moment to
reflect.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As much as I hate to disturb you,
Trainer, it's
about time we faced the
press.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A little while. I meant to get your
attention, but
you seemed lost in
thought.
choice_data_list: Wait, how long have you been standing there?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If it's important, I can give you a
moment.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
choice_data_list: I was just looking back on the past three years.
I was just looking back on the past three years.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They passed us by in an instant, didn't
they? Time
truly does fly like an arrow.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But let's not be so hasty as to sink into

melancholy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The media awaits us. The eyes of the
world are
still on us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You wouldn't abandon my dream at this
late
hour, would you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A fine answer, and just the one I had
hoped for.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Come, Trainer. Let us set out once more.
Our
journey is far from over.
